const int MAX_NODES = 5005;
using ll = long long;
const ll INF = 1000000007LL;
const int MAX_TIME = 100;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    ll cap, flow, cost;
};

struct MCMF {
    int n, m, s, t;
    vector<int> G[MAX_NODES];
    vector<Edge> edges;
    ll dist[MAX_NODES];
    bool inq[MAX_NODES];
    int prev_edge[MAX_NODES];
    ll min_cap[MAX_NODES];

    MCMF(int total_nodes) : n(total_nodes) {}

    void add_edge(int u, int v, ll capacity, ll expense) {
        edges.push_back({u, v, capacity, 0, expense});
        edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -expense});
        m = edges.size();
        G[u].push_back(m - 2);
        G[v].push_back(m - 1);
    }

    bool bellman_ford(ll &flow_sent, ll &total_cost) {
        fill(dist, dist + n, INF);
        fill(inq, inq + n, false);
        dist[s] = 0;
        inq[s] = true;
        prev_edge[s] = 0;
        min_cap[s] = INF;

        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inq[u] = false;

            for (int idx : G[u]) {
                Edge &e = edges[idx];
                if (e.cap > e.flow && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                    dist[e.v] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    prev_edge[e.v] = idx;
                    min_cap[e.v] = min(min_cap[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                    if (!inq[e.v]) {
                        q.push(e.v);
                        inq[e.v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[t] == INF) return false;
        flow_sent = min_cap[t];
        total_cost = dist[t];
        int cur = t;
        while (cur != s) {
            edges[prev_edge[cur]].flow += min_cap[t];
            edges[prev_edge[cur] ^ 1].flow -= min_cap[t];
            cur = edges[prev_edge[cur]].u;
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<ll, ll> compute_min_cost_flow(int source, int sink) {
        s = source;
        t = sink;
        ll total_cost = 0;
        ll total_flow = 0;
        ll flow_per_iteration, cost_per_flow;

        while (bellman_ford(flow_per_iteration, cost_per_flow)) {
            total_flow += flow_per_iteration;
            total_cost += flow_per_iteration * cost_per_flow;
        }
        return {total_flow, total_cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, C, D_val;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> C >> D_val;

    MCMF solver(n * MAX_TIME + 2);
    int source = n * MAX_TIME, sink = n * MAX_TIME + 1;

    for (int t = 0; t < MAX_TIME; t++)
        solver.add_edge(t, sink, k, C * t);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;

        solver.add_edge(source, x * MAX_TIME, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)

    while (m--) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;

        for (int t = 1; t < MAX_TIME; t++) {
            int from1 = u * MAX_TIME + t - 1;
            int to1 = v * MAX_TIME + t;
            int from2 = v * MAX_TIME + t - 1;
            int to2 = u * MAX_TIME + t;

            for (int j = 1, cost_val = D_val; j <= k; j++, cost_val += 2 * D_val) {
                solver.add_edge(from1, to1, 1, cost_val);
                solver.add_edge(from2, to2, 1, cost_val);

        }

    auto result = solver.compute_min_cost_flow(source, sink);

    bool visited[MAX_N];
    int parent_edge[MAX_N];
    lint bottleneck[MAX_N];

    MinCostMaxFlow(int total_nodes) : num_nodes(total_nodes), num_edges(0) {}

    void connect(int u, int v, lint capacity, lint weight) {
        edge_list.push_back({u, v, capacity, 0LL, weight});
        edge_list.push_back({v, u, 0LL, 0LL, -weight});
        int idx = edge_list.size();
        adj[u].push_back(idx - 2);
        adj[v].push_back(idx - 1);
    }

        fill(dist_arr, dist_arr + num_nodes, BIG);
        fill(visited, visited + num_nodes, false);
        dist_arr[src] = 0;
        visited[src] = true;
        bottleneck[src] = BIG;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(src);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int node = q.front();
            q.pop();
            visited[node] = false;

            for (int eid : adj[node]) {
                Edge &e = edge_list[eid];
                if (e.cap > e.flow && dist_arr[e.to] > dist_arr[node] + e.cost) {
                    dist_arr[e.to] = dist_arr[node] + e.cost;
                    parent_edge[e.to] = eid;
                    bottleneck[e.to] = min(bottleneck[node], e.cap - e.flow);

                    if (!visited[e.to]) {
                        q.push(e.to);
                        visited[e.to] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist_arr[dst] == BIG) return false;

        flow = bottleneck[dst];
        cost_per_unit = dist_arr[dst];
        int cur = dst;
        while (cur != src) {
            edge_list[parent_edge[cur]].flow += bottleneck[dst];
            edge_list[parent_edge[cur] ^ 1].flow -= bottleneck[dst];
            cur = edge_list[parent_edge[cur]].from;
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<lint, lint> solve(int source, int destination) {
        src = source;
        dst = destination;
        lint total_flow = 0;
        lint min_cost = 0;
        lint f, c;

        while (shortest_path(f, c)) {
            total_flow += f;
            min_cost += f * c;

        return {total_flow, min_cost};
    }

    cin >> n >> m >> k >> C >> D;

    MinCostMaxFlow g(n * MAX_T + 2);
    int src_node = n * MAX_T;
    int dst_node = n * MAX_T + 1;

using namespace std;

typedef long long lint;

const lint INF = 1000000007LL;
const int MAX_NODE = 5005;
const int MAX_TIME = 100;

struct edge_t {
    int from;
    int to;
    lint capacity;
    lint flow;
    lint cost;
};

class MCMF {
public:
    int nodes;
    vector<int> adj[MAX_NODE];
    vector<edge_t> edges;
    lint distance[MAX_NODE];
    bool inqueue[MAX_NODE];
    int prev_edge_index[MAX_NODE];
    lint min_flow_on_path[MAX_NODE];

    MCMF(int n) : nodes(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) adj[i].clear();
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, lint cap, lint cst) {
        edges.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cst});
        edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cst});
        int idx = edges.size() - 2;
        adj[u].push_back(idx);
        adj[v].push_back(idx + 1);
    }

    bool computePath(lint &flow_on_this_path, lint &cost_per_flow) {
        fill(distance, distance + nodes, INF);
        fill(inqueue, inqueue + nodes, false);
        distance[0] = 0; // We'll set source later
        memset(inqueue, false, sizeof(bool) * nodes);
        memset(prev_edge_index, -1, sizeof(int) * nodes);

        queue<int> q;
        q.push(0);
        distance[0] = 0;
        inqueue[0] = true;
        min_flow_on_path[0] = INF;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            inqueue[u] = false;

            for (int eidx : adj[u]) {
                edge_t &e = edges[eidx];
                if (e.capacity > e.flow && distance[e.to] > distance[u] + e.cost) {
                    distance[e.to] = distance[u] + e.cost;
                    prev_edge_index[e.to] = eidx;
                    min_flow_on_path[e.to] = min(min_flow_on_path[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                    if (!inqueue[e.to]) {
                        q.push(e.to);
                        inqueue[e.to] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (distance[1] == INF) return false;

        flow_on_this_path = min_flow_on_path[1];
        cost_per_flow = distance[1];
        int cur = 1;
        while (cur != 0) {
            int eidx = prev_edge_index[cur];
            edges[eidx].flow += flow_on_this_path;
            edges[eidx ^ 1].flow -= flow_on_this_path;
            cur = edges[eidx].from;
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<lint, lint> getMinCostFlow(int src, int dst) {
        this->nodes = this->nodes;
        int original_nodes = nodes;
        nodes = original_nodes;

        int old_src = 0, old_dst = 1;
        // Adjust node mapping: shift everything so src and dst go where expected
        for (auto &e : edges) {
            e.from = (e.from == 0 ? src : (e.from == 1 ? dst : e.from));
            e.to   = (e.to   == 0 ? src : (e.to   == 1 ? dst : e.to));
        }

        lint total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
        lint flow, cost;

        while (computePath(flow, cost)) {
            total_flow += flow;
            total_cost += flow * cost;
        }

        return make_pair(total_flow, total_cost);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, C, D;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> C >> D;

    int total_nodes = n * MAX_TIME + 2;
    MCMF solver(total_nodes);
    int source_id = n * MAX_TIME;
    int sink_id   = n * MAX_TIME + 1;

    for (int t = 0; t < MAX_TIME; ++t)
        solver.addEdge(t, sink_id, k, C * t);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        x--;
        solver.addEdge(source_id, x * MAX_TIME, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int t = 1; t < MAX_TIME; ++t)
            solver.addEdge(i * MAX_TIME + t - 1, i * MAX_TIME + t, k, 0);

    while (m--) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;

        for (int t = 1; t < MAX_TIME; ++t) {
            int a = u * MAX_TIME + t - 1;
            int b = v * MAX_TIME + t;
            int c = v * MAX_TIME + t - 1;
            int d = u * MAX_TIME + t;

            for (int i = 1, cc = D; i <= k; ++i, cc += 2 * D) {
                solver.addEdge(a, b, 1, cc);
                solver.addEdge(c, d, 1, cc);
            }
        }
    }

    auto result = solver.getMinCostFlow(source_id, sink_id);
    cout << result.second << endl;
}

public:

    vector<int> g[MAX_NODE_LIMIT];
    vector<Edge> e;
    i64 dist[MAX_NODE_LIMIT];
    bool vis[MAX_NODE_LIMIT];
    int par_edge[MAX_NODE_LIMIT];
    i64 cap_on_path[MAX_NODE_LIMIT];

    MinCostFlowSolver(int total_nodes) : n(total_nodes) {}

    void link(int u, int v, i64 cap, i64 c) {
        e.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, c});
        e.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -c});

        g[u].push_back(idx - 2);
        g[v].push_back(idx - 1);
    }

        fill(dist, dist + n, INF);
        fill(vis, vis + n, false);
        queue<int> q;
        dist[0] = 0;
        vis[0] = true;
        cap_on_path[0] = INF;
        q.push(0);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            vis[u] = false;
            for (int idx : g[u]) {

                if (ed.capacity > ed.flow && dist[ed.dst] > dist[u] + ed.cost_val) {
                    dist[ed.dst] = dist[u] + ed.cost_val;
                    par_edge[ed.dst] = idx;
                    cap_on_path[ed.dst] = min(cap_on_path[u], ed.capacity - ed.flow);
                    if (!vis[ed.dst]) {
                        vis[ed.dst] = true;
                        q.push(ed.dst);

                }
            }

        if (dist[1] == INF) return false;
        f = cap_on_path[1];
        c = dist[1];
        int cur = 1;

            int idx = par_edge[cur];
            e[idx].flow += f;
            e[idx ^ 1].flow -= f;
            cur = e[idx].src;
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<i64, i64> mincost(int src, int dst) {
        int orig_n = n;
